addition.item: FullCalendar 7.1.4: about 400 KB of JavaScript per page instead of 1.6 MB, with no jQuery or moment.js.

Website Style theme (default for new calendars): the calendar takes its colors, buttons and title font from your YOOtheme style, also in dark sections (including styles without inverse colors) and with the dark color scheme, with white or black event text where the style's text color doesn't read on an Event Color.
New themes UIkit 3, Monarch, Forma, Breezy and Pulse with color palettes, and a Light, Dark or Auto color scheme for each calendar.
New views: Time Grid Week and Day, Multi-Month Year, Timeline Week and Month, Resource Time Grid Week, with toolbar buttons for them and for the Year view.
Style tab: Title (YOOtheme headline style, decoration, font family, color, heading level), Toolbar Buttons (style, active style, size), Events, Calendar Grid and Categories.
Hover: Zoom, Zoom with Shadow, Lift, Glow or Brighten, with Zoom Size and Speed, plus Focus (the other events fade) and a Tooltip with the time and full title.
Title Icons next to event titles, with UIkit icons and ZOOlanders Essentials icon collections.
Category Headers in the colors of their events (Timeline and Resource Time Grid views).
Date Handling "Accurate": all-day events land on the entered day, times use the calendar's time zone, recurring events keep their weekday, length and end date.
Excluded Dates for recurring events (with Date Handling Accurate).
Toolbar layouts with a centered title, Day Button Opens and Clicked Date Opens.
Events Per Day with a "+ more" popover, Week Numbers, Now Indicator, Business Hours, Initial Scroll Time and End Times.

Dynamic Content for the calendar's settings too, not only its items: text, color and select settings can be mapped (not the on/off switches or the General options, nor the Style tab's Title style, decoration, font and color, Toolbar Buttons, Hover and Category Headers options).
Labels you leave empty follow the calendar's language (81 FullCalendar translations, right-to-left languages included), and events and modals can be reached with the keyboard.

change.item: Installation and updates check for PHP 8.1+, Joomla 5+ and YOOtheme Pro 4+ and stop with a clear message; the plugin is enabled right after installing.

The Download ID entered in the plugin settings is now used for updates: Calendar Pro copies it to its Update Site. For the update from 1.x, upload the 2.0 zip or enter the Download ID on the Update Site first.
Calendars saved with 1.x keep their look and their Legacy date handling. Switch them to Accurate when you're ready.
Recurring events show their full length (start to end), also in calendars saved with 1.x.

Custom CSS from 1.x keeps matching the main FullCalendar classes (fc-event, fc-event-title, fc-button, fc-day-today). CSS that colored category headers by position (.fc-col-header-cell:nth-child) no longer matches: use the Event Colors option of Category Headers in the Style tab.
The search field shows in the toolbar right away (no Search button to click) and also matches the category and content. Date Navigation is now called Clickable Dates.
The URL of every Calendar Pro file carries a checksum, so browsers and CDNs load the new files after an update.

The Print button prints only its calendar, without the header, menus and everything else on the page, laid out for paper by FullCalendar: every event of the view (no + more link), also with a fixed Calendar Height.

fix.item: The Week button showed six weeks when Fixed Weeks was on.
An End Time at or before the Start Time (e.g. 12:00 AM) is on the next day.
Modal content, "Open in a new window", Limit Start Date and the Modal width, height, full screen, padding and margin settings work again.
Several calendars on one page no longer interfere with each other; email cloaking stays active on pages with a calendar.
Titles and categories written with HTML character codes, such as the code of the registered trademark sign, show the character itself on the calendar, in modals and in the search.

security.item: Event titles, categories, links and Dynamic Content values are safely encoded.

remove.item: jQuery, moment.js, moment-timezone and the Bootstrap 5 stylesheet are no longer loaded. The Bootstrap 5, Flatly and Minty themes use Classic.

addition.item: Added Joomla 5.4+ / 6+ and PHP 8.1+ through 8.4+ support
Added comprehensive input validation for all date and timezone fields
Added fallback values for all calendar settings
Added additional user-facing security and prevention methods

fix.item: Fixed "Array to string conversion" error that prevented calendar from displaying
Fixed JavaScript syntax errors caused by invalid timezone or date values
Fixed PHP warnings on undefined properties in PHP 8.x
Fixed calendar not rendering when timezone was set to "local"
Fixed recurring events not displaying when end date was invalid

remove.item: Removed Joomla 3 support and legacy/deprecated code

fix.item: Thanks to user Francis Valenzuela for helping update the print code for a better printing/user experience.
Minor code revisions and updates.

remove.item: htmlspecialchars() removed from content filter so html is rendered correctly. Dynamic content shouldn't be affected by this change. Text editors or raw code can now be edited or updated without issues.

addition.item: Added a div and id "cal-email-cloak" to the Email Cloak tag so it may be manually manipulated via css if required. NOTE: This is only shown when the Joomla Email Cloak plugin is disabled.

fix.item: Changed "Modal Title" to just the "Title" to show the correct title when opening a modal window/pop-up on each event.
Updated FullCalendar Base JS Version to: 6.1.18

addition.item: Recurring by specific days has been added in per event. NOTE: There is a larger known issue where your event may jump to a day before or a day after your desired day based on your time zone selection. Just choose a different day to offset it, or change the time on your event a few hours one way or another at this time.

fix.item: Changed some of the test date, time and time zone text in the modals.
Refactored some code and cleaned up a minor time error if no time zone was selected.
Changed Text Color in each Calendar item to override the default main text color in settings. This only works when a background color is used, like a multi day event or timeline view.
Moved "Event Text Color" in Main Calendar Pro element settings so you can set a default text color.
Added a "Show Past Events" option to force all events in the past dates to show.

addition.item: Custom End Dates are still available with the optional checkbox that's now added to limit the end date.

fix.item: Changed "Limit End Date" to include preset time periods from today's date (i.e. 1 month, 1 year, etc.).
Minor custom changes and code cleanup to prevent a date bug.

addition.item: Included the option to globally hide the date title

fix.item: Fixed default "local" time zone to use the user's browser time to avoid errors.
Fixed date headers showing for future events if maz events were limited
Minor code changes and clearup for dates, time zones and max events

addition.item: If Modal is disabled, the event link can be used when the event is clicked on

fix.item: Reorganized options in the main element view for Display & Modal/Link options
Event would disappear when modal options were disabled.

addition.item: If loading is needed for more events, a loading icon will now show. This is rare in most setups.
Lazy loading for when a lot of events are needing to load at once.
"Hide Past Events From Today" as an option for the "Limit Start Date" of events that will always use "today's" date.

fix.item: Move some code around to work better with multiple events needing the date/time/timezone, etc.
Fixed update URL
"Start Date" now works as expected
Print fuction updated and print button only prints calendar now.
Refactored some code and scripts for better loads
Search Bar style fix & better reset reliability

addition.item: Calendar Pro Element - First Release for YOOtheme Pro
